title: External Painting of Thangasseri point Lighthouse, Kollam district
summary: Sealed quotation for external painting of the Thangasseri Point lighthouse tower in Kollam district, Kerala, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

scope.item: External painting of Thangasseri Point lighthouse tower as per schedule of items (Annexure-I, not included in this document)

notes: One-page NIQ only; schedule of items (Annexure-I) and terms not attached. Blank forms available 24.08.2026 to 31.08.2026 (10:00-16:00) from the Directorate at Kochi and the Station in Charge, Thangasseri Point Lighthouse; quotations due 01.09.2026 by 15:00. Hindi text calls the work painting of the Thangasseri Point tower. Listing end date 2026-08-31 corresponds to last date of issue of forms.
